title: 6.4.4 Lab: Sink it
description: The table with a pocket: a slow ball drops, a fast one rolls over, and the game says what happened.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The pocket is solid: aim at it and the ball bounces off.

steps.title: Pass-through and the slow rule
steps.instructions: Add `collider = 'none'` to the pocket and the guarded slow drop from the sub-build.

steps.title: Say what happened
steps.instructions: When the ball drops, show "Pocketed" in the middle, and keep the ball there until R puts it back.
hints: A ball that vanishes means it was deleted; the round should keep it.

requirements.title: The pocket is pass-through
requirements.description: The pocket has collider none. Help: 6.4.1 (Reading: Overlaps: a question, not a collision)

requirements.title: Slow drop, guarded
requirements.description: Overlap plus speed test, once. Help: 6.4.1 (Overlaps) and 6.4.2 (A pocket you roll over)

requirements.title: The game says so
requirements.description: Words appear when the ball is sunk. Help: 5.7.1 (Reading: Words on a sprite)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Sink it". The task: make the pocket pass-through, drop a slow ball into it once, and show a word when it is sunk. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Slow and once
rubric.description: A speed test and a guard.

rubric.title: Feedback
rubric.description: A word or a message shows the ball was pocketed.
